sentences: Novartis's shares moved 5% or more on 2 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 19 November 2026, when the stock fell 2.6%.
The stock is up 9.1% this year, and at $150.47 it sits 10.8% below its 52-week closing high of $168.62 from 27 February 2026.
$1,000 invested in Novartis five years ago would be worth $1,905 today.
